core_obligations: Statement (lines 4353-4366): for a site C with equalizers and fibre products and a hypercovering K, the Cech complex a_{0,*}a_0^{-1}F -> a_{1,*}a_1^{-1}F -> ... of Lemma lemma-augmentation-cech-complex equals the complex SheafHom(s(Z_{F(K)}^#), F).
Term identification (proof lines 4368-4374): by Lemma lemma-push-pull-localization each term is a_{n,*}a_n^{-1}F = SheafHom'(F(K_n)^#, F), where SheafHom' is the Sites glueing-section version.

Boundary identification (lines 4374-4382): the boundary maps of the Cech complex come from the simplicial structure; hence the equality of complexes follows from the canonical identifications SheafHom'(G, F) = SheafHom(Z_G, F) for G in Sh(C).
proof_roadmap: Identify each term via the push-pull localization formula.
Note both boundary systems come from the simplicial structure.
Transport the identification through the canonical Hom-of-free-sheaf adjunction.
difficulty_reason: Complex-identification lemma (statement 4353-4366, proof 4368-4382): the hypercovering Cech complex is Hom from the normalized complex of the sheafified free simplicial object - the proof identifies all terms by the push-pull formula (in-source, proven) and transfers the boundary maps through the canonical adjunction SheafHom'(G, F) = SheafHom(Z_G, F), both sides' differentials arising from the same simplicial structure; terse but no step is omitted or delegated. H3.
